{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ei'shunn Aa Effect''' was a scientific paradox created by the [[Novolek Beacon/Legends|Novolek Beacon]], a rare trans-dimensional energy streamer [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsar]]. [[Gravity/Legends|Gravitational]] curves intersected through the [[Star/Legends|star]], creating a convergence of [[Mass shadow/Legends|mass shadows]] and placing the star under great stress. The gravitational curves were not uniform, and the intersecting stresses would force a portion of the star to explode into [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]], releasing high-energy [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]]. It caused immense disturbances throughout a local area of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], stretching the walls between dimensions and disrupting subspace communications.<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
